candidates.excerpt: State election commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha issued an order here on Friday with an allotment of symbol of ‘Bat’ for Jayeeta Sama Samajam Party, ‘Battery Torch’ for Bharatha Chaitanya Yuvajana Party and ‘Gas Cylinder’ to Rashtriya Praja Congress (Secular) Party.
